title: Road of Choice
next_chapter_hook: At the moment the Tianji Record Noumenon emitted that mournful cry, in the Nine Heavens above, countless eyes opened simultaneously—the gaze of the Heavenly Celestial Eye, the terrifying will surpassing ten thousand years of chess games, for the first time truly fixing its attention on this ant who dared to overturn the chessboard.

text.content: Inside the Tianji Hall, the shattered star chart still trembled slightly. Ye Qing's figure had vanished within the light of the teleportation array, leaving only her final words echoing in the air—"Some threads, even I cannot sever." Chen Ji stood in place, his fingers in his sleeve gently rubbing the edge of the Tianji Record Fragment. He did not chase after her. Not because he didn't want to, but because there was something more important that needed to be faced at this moment. He slowly turned around, his gaze passing through layer upon layer of prohibition formations, landing on that statue that had remained silent throughout—the true form of the former Sect Master, Ling Yuan. Chen Nian stood three chi beside Chen Ji, her eyes that usually carried smiles now bloodshot. She had just witnessed those visions with her own eyes, seen the truth of her mother being imprisoned, understood her own significance as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Now she finally understood why her brother had endured years of being called atrash rather than revealing even a fraction of his true strength. "Brother," she spoke softly, her voice hoarse as if scraped by sandpaper, "What should we do next..."

Chen Ji repeated these four words, as if savoring something laughable. He raised his head, his gaze passing through the layers of prohibition formations, landing on that golden mass of light that had always hovered at the highest point of the Tianji Hall—the residual will projection of the Tianji Record Noumenon, the collective obsession left behind by generations of writers after death. It was silent, yet constantly radiating a suffocating pressure. For ten thousand years, all prophets who obtained fragments of the Tianji Record faced the same choice: destroy the Heavenly Celestial Eye, allowing this chaotic world to end completely; or become the new Heavenly Celestial Eye, reshaping order with one's own strength. Either path required sacrifice—sacrificing others' lives, one's own soul, everything one treasured. Chen Ji's father Chen Xuan chose the first path. And he died halfway.

dialogue.content: "I have no interest in being some savior, nor any interest in being some new deity."

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it stirred layers of echoes in this spacious hall. He took a step forward. That step seemed ordinary, yet it caused the entire floor of the Tianji Hall to tremble slightly. The golden mass of light seemed to sense something, its originally gentle glow suddenly becoming dazzlingly bright, like a slumbering beast opening its eyes. "Are you threatening me?" Chen Ji tilted his head, a mocking arc tugging at the corner of his mouth, "With your half-dead appearance?" He raised the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, and the golden patterns on the fragment were flickering at a nearly frantic frequency. That was the will of the Tianji Record Noumenon—it was angry, afraid, and for the first time, showed its claws before this human who dared to defy it.

The statue suddenly cracked open, and Ling Yuan's figure burst out from within. This old Sect Master who had lain dormant for years now showed no trace of pretense, his full head of white hair wildly fluttering under the agitation of True Qi, his eyes burning with almost tangible killing intent. His palm stretched out, and a giant palm formed entirely from pure Spiritual Energy materialized out of thin air, slamming fiercely toward Chen Ji's fontanel. "Do you think your meager cultivation can defy the will of the Tianji Record?" Ling Yuan's voice was like thunder, "This old man has waited for this day for eight hundred years! The Tianji Record chose me, it chose Ling Yuan! Your father couldn't take it away, and you shall not either!" Chen Ji did not dodge. He didn't even raise his eyelids.

Chen Nian's figure suddenly blocked in front of Chen Ji, her slender body appearing so fragile before Ling Yuan's giant palm, yet so firm at the same time. Her hands formed a strange seal before her—that was the Chen family's ancestral technique, "Heavenly Fate Lock Release"—a forbidden method that used one's own essence blood as a catalyst to forcibly interrupt forbidden arts. The giant palm stopped abruptly three chi above her head. Ling Yuan's pupils slightly contracted, seemingly not expecting this seemingly powerless little girl to be able to execute such a secret technique. "Chen family remnant," he coldly snorted, yet his attack did not cease, the force in his palm even increasing by three tenths, "Do you think this can stop me?"
"Whether it can stop me isn't for you to decide."

Chen Ji's voice came from behind Chen Nian, still that unruffled tone, yet carrying a chill that made one's spine crawl. He gently pulled Chen Nian behind him, then raised his head, directly facing Ling Yuan's eyes filled with greed and hatred. "Ling Yuan," he pronounced each word deliberately, "Eight hundred years ago, what you lost to my father wasn't just the right of inheritance to the Tianji Record, but your Dao heart. From that day on, your cultivation never advanced a single step, because you were no longer a cultivator, but a puppet of the Tianji Record Noumenon." Ling Yuan's expression drastically changed, that giant palm trembling violently in mid-air. He wanted to retort, but found his throat seeming to be gripped by something, unable to utter a single word.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji spoke of that third path that no generation of writers had dared to imagine—

choices.description: Completely sever the connection between the Tianji Record and the Heavenly Celestial Eye, so that this ten-thousand-year chess game would cease to exist—but the cost was that all prophets would lose their ability to foresee the future.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all abilities of the Tianji Record Fragment
choices.visible_reward: Completely break free from the shackles of fate
choices.risk_hint: The cost of this path was too dire, and Ling Yuan would never stand by and watch

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, the golden patterns on it beating violently, as if sensing something terrible about to happen. "The first path," his voice echoed through the silent hall, "is to destroy this chess game. Destroy all connections between the Tianji Record and the Heavenly Celestial Eye, causing the chessboard that has manipulated the fates of all beings for ten thousand years to completely collapse." The golden mass of light suddenly emitted a sharp mournful cry, the fear contained within that sound causing even Ling Yuan to take an involuntary step back.

choices.description: Accept the inheritance of the Tianji Record Noumenon and become the new Heavenly Celestial Eye—with Chen Ji's disposition, was this salvation or another form of corruption?
choices.visible_cost: Must accept partial will assimilation from the Tianji Record Noumenon
choices.visible_reward: Gain the power to rewrite the rules
choices.risk_hint: The will of the Tianji Record Noumenon is far more dangerous than imagined, the assimilation process is irreversible

text.content: "The second path," Chen Ji's tone suddenly turned cold, "is to become the new chess player. Accept the inheritance of this broken body, take the place of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, and reshape this ravaged world with my will." His gaze fell on Ling Yuan, carrying a hint of amusement, "Ling Yuan, isn't this what you've always wanted? Unfortunately, I don't find this path appealing either."

choices.description: Chen Ji refused to make any choice between these two options—he intended to use his authority as the "Author" to completely rewrite the core rules of this ten-thousand-year chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Unknown—this path has never been attempted by anyone
choices.visible_reward: To free everyone from the chess game, including those manipulated "pieces"
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao will never permit anyone to challenge its rules; it will surely bring down heavenly punishment

text.content: Chen Ji's lips slowly curved upward, his smile carrying three parts mockery, three parts amusement, and four parts overwhelming ambition. "But I choose the third path." These six words fell, and the entire Tianji Hall fell silent for a moment. The golden light orb's pulsation abruptly ceased, as if even it couldn't believe what it had heard. "The third path?" Ling Yuan's voice trembled, whether from anger or fear. "In over ten thousand years, no one has ever walked the third path! What makes you think you can—" "What makes me think?" Chen Ji cut him off, speaking word by word, "Because I am Chen Xuan's son, because of my fifteen years of planning, and because none of you fools have ever understood this game!"

He abruptly hurled the Tianji Record Fragment into the air, his hands forming an ancient and complex seal. That seal was the forbidden technique Chen Xuan had engraved into his soul before his death—the "Author's True Explanation," a forbidden method that could briefly invoke the highest authority of the Tianji Record itself, never successfully performed by anyone. The fragment suddenly unfolded in mid-air, those originally broken golden patterns beginning to spread wildly like a giant net spreading in all directions. Every pattern that landed in the Void stirred visible ripples—that was the backlash generated when rules were rewritten.

dialogue.content: Stop! Do you know what you're doing? This will bring heavenly retribution!

text.content: Heavenly retribution? Chen Ji sneered, his movements showing no hesitation. The patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment grew brighter and brighter, almost piercing everyone's retinas. He could feel his Heavenly Fate Value depleting at an alarming rate—every rule rewritten cost a full ten points of Heavenly Fate. But he didn't care. From the day he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, he had been waiting for this moment. Waiting for an opportunity to overturn this chess game.

Chen Nian rushed to Chen Ji's side without hesitation, pressing both hands on his back. She had no cultivation, but she had bloodline—Chen family's direct bloodline was the key to opening certain seals. The siblings' powers converged, and that golden net suddenly accelerated its formation, instantly covering the entire Tianji Hall. Ling Yuan tried to intervene but was repelled by the sudden burst of power from the golden light orb. He stared at everything in disbelief, his lips quivering: "Mad... you've all gone mad... this will destroy everyone... the Eye of Heavenly Dao won't let you off..."

Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold without a trace of emotion. He turned to look at Ling Yuan, his eyes carrying a nearly pitiful mockery. "Ling Yuan, do you truly believe the Eye of Heavenly Dao is still protecting this world?" He pointed to the golden light orb above, "It is merely another, higher-level chess player. All of us—in his eyes, you, my father, Ye Qing, even those high-and-mighty sect masters—are merely pieces." He paused, his lips curling into a mocking arc, "And you, playing the role of a piece for eight hundred years, yet enjoying it, thinking that one day you could become a chess player. How laughable."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan trembled violently from Chen Ji's words; now he faced his final choice—

choices.text: Abandon resistance and join the third path
choices.description: Ling Yuan finally realized how laughable his eight-hundred-year obsession had been. He chose to let go, joining Chen Ji to rewrite the ten-thousand-year chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon eight hundred years of obsession and acknowledge defeat
choices.visible_reward: Gain a certain degree of trust from Chen Ji
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is fickle and treacherous; no one knows if he is genuine or has ulterior motives

text.content: Ling Yuan's body froze in place, his face cycling through green and white. Chen Ji's words were like a dull blade, peeling away layer by layer his eight-hundred-year beautiful dream, revealing the rotting truth within. He wanted to refute but found no words. Because Chen Ji spoke the truth. He truly had been a piece for eight hundred years, and he had willingly stepped onto the chessboard himself. "Enough..." Ling Yuan's voice suddenly became incomparably ancient, like an ancient tree withering in the wind, "This old one has waited for this day... for far too long. So long that I nearly forgot why I walked this path in the first place." He slowly closed his eyes, hands falling limply, without a trace of fighting intent.

choices.text: Refuse to submit unto death, coexist with and perish alongside the chess game
choices.description: Ling Yuan could not accept the collapse of his eight-hundred-year obsession. He chose to die for his principles, resisting Chen Ji's mad plan in the most resolute manner.
choices.visible_cost: Completely offend Chen Ji, losing all avenues of retreat
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the final dignity as an established senior power
choices.risk_hint: Although Ling Yuan's strength had stagnated for eight hundred years, after all, he was once a top-tier expert, and his desperate last strike should not be underestimated.

text.content: Ling Yuan's eyes snapped open, burning with an almost manic light. "Chen Ji! Do you think you've already won?" He let out a roar to the heavens, and the True Qi accumulated over eight hundred years in his body rushed outward like a breached flood, desperately pouring out. He was going to self-destruct! Even in death, he wanted to drag Chen Ji down with him! But Chen Ji had anticipated this. He merely lifted his hand gently, and the golden giant net covering the entire Heavenly Secrets Hall suddenly tightened, firmly suppressing Ling Yuan's True Qi within his body. "Want to die?" Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of languor. "Did you ask my permission?"

At this moment, a strange fluctuation suddenly came from outside the Heavenly Secrets Hall. Chen Ji recognized that fluctuation's aura intimately—it was Ye Qing, the residual "Demonic Path Mist" she had left behind when she departed just moments ago. Yet in the next instant, a graceful figure emerged from the mist, unmistakably Ye Qing, who should have already left. Behind her followed a figure Chen Ji had never seen before—a middle-aged man in black robes, surrounded by dense demonic energy, yet possessing a pair of eyes so clear they were nearly transparent.

Ye Qing's voice was cold and clear, yet carried an undisguised excitement. She walked to Chen Ji's side, her gaze falling upon the continuously expanding golden net in his hand, her eyes flickering with a complex light. "After leaving just now, I used the Demonic Path Mist to shield myself from the Holy Sect's pursuit." She paused. "Within that mist, I saw some... things." She didn't elaborate, but Chen Ji noticed her hands trembling slightly. "Those things made me understand that the third path you speak of might be the only way out." She raised her head, meeting Chen Ji's gaze. "The Demonic Path Holy Sect is willing to form an alliance with you."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Holy Sect? An alliance?

text.content: Chen Ji raised an eyebrow, his gaze shifting between Ye Qing and the black-robed man. To be honest, he had never fully trusted this woman. Even though she had helped him, even though her circumstances truly deserved sympathy, people of the Demonic Path had treacherous minds—who knew what schemes she was plotting. Yet in the next instant, the black-robed man spoke. "This old one is the current Sect Master of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, Ye Wuya." His voice was deep and low, yet carried an undeniable pressure. "And also Ye Qing's biological father." Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly. This name, he had seen in the records of the Tianji Record Fragment. Eight hundred years ago, it was this person who had engaged in an earth-shaking confrontation with Chen Ji's father, Chen Xuan. The outcome of that battle was not recorded in historical texts, but from the fragments Chen Ji had gleaned, he deduced that Ye Wuya had lost—lost terribly.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, remember this old man's words—the third path is not without precedent.

text.content: A weathered voice suddenly rang out in Chen Ji's mind. It was Mo Xiansheng—that mysterious existence dwelling as a remnant soul on the first page of the Tianji Record. Chen Ji's heart trembled. This old fox, always acting mysterious and unpredictable, why would he speak at this exact moment? He wanted to question further, but Mo Xiansheng's voice had already vanished, leaving only a profoundly meaningful phrase echoing in his mind: "The price of the third path is greater than you can imagine. But the rewards will also exceed your expectations." Chen Ji took a deep breath, temporarily suppressing the doubts in his heart. Regardless, the situation before him had become much clearer now. Even if Ling Yuan didn't turn against him, he lacked the strength to stop Chen Ji; Ye Qing's return and Ye Wuya's appearance had greatly increased the feasibility of the third path; and Chen Nian's support eliminated all his concerns.

Very well. Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet carried a compelling force. Since the Demonic Path Holy Sect is willing to form an alliance, then let it be an alliance. He raised his hand, and the golden net rapidly contracted, eventually condensing into a fist-sized sphere of light, floating above his palm. Within the sphere, countless tiny runes continuously circulated—these were rules he had already rewritten, or rather, rules about to be rewritten. "Everyone," he gazed around, his eyes sweeping across each face, "the essence of the third path is neither destruction nor replacement." His voice echoed through the great hall. "It is fundamentally rewriting the rules of this ten-thousand-year chess game. To liberate all controlled pieces—including you, including Ye Qing, including every creature in this world bound by fate—from the shackles of the game entirely."

The golden light cluster—the Tianji Record's true will projection—suddenly trembled violently. It seemed to finally realize that this ant-like human was serious. He truly intended to shake its ten-thousand-year foundation, truly intended to reduce all its painstaking efforts to nothing. A terrifying pressure suddenly poured forth from the light cluster—that was the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, power beyond all else. Yet Chen Ji merely smiled contemptuously. He tossed the light sphere in his palm into the air, and the sphere expanded instantly, transforming in moments into a brilliant pillar of light, shooting straight up into the clouds. Wherever the pillar passed, all forbidden formations collapsed; all fate threads binding all beings turned to虚无. This is the third path. Chen Ji's voice resounded like divine proclamation beside everyone's ears. Not destruction, not submission—but transcendence.

Outside the Heavenly Secrets Hall, high above the nine heavens, a furious roar echoed faintly. It was the Heavenly Eye's true本体 awakening in the faraway Heavens Beyond Heavens. It sensed that the rules it had laid down were being rewritten, sensed that the ant daring to defy it was prying at its ten-thousand-year foundation. An unprecedented pressure descended from above, like an invisible giant hand, slamming down fiercely toward the Heavenly Secrets Hall. Ling Yuan's face turned ashen: "It... it's truly furious..." Ye Wuya's brow furrowed tightly: "The Heavenly Eye's true will... this is no laughing matter..." Chen Nian unconsciously clenched his fists, his knuckles white. Yet Chen Ji still stood in place, gazing up at the descending pressure, a smile even curling at the corner of his lips. "Angry?" he murmured to himself. "Good. Being angry proves I've struck its weakness."

He slowly raised both hands, and the giant net woven from golden patterns unfolded once more, like a massive shield hovering above everyone's heads. When the pressure collided with the net, a thunderous roar erupted. The entire Heavenly Secrets Hall shook violently, countless fragments of stone falling from the dome. Yet the net remained as steady as bedrock, even growing brighter under the pressure's assault. Chen Ji knew this was merely the Heavenly Eye's probing attack. The real storm was still to come. But he was prepared. The third path—he had taken the first step. From now on, no matter how arduous the road ahead, he would never turn back. This was his choice. His path.
